Visit note | 2026-03-14 12:00 PM | Dr. Selina Parvin, Neurology | Patient: Parvez Miah, 74, male. Mr. Miah attends for a review of his ongoing foot symptoms, reporting numbness in his toes, a burning sensation in both feet, and discomfort that feels worse at night.
